title: Entitled Girl Thinks Her Parents Can Get Her Out Of A DUI
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On February 26th, 2023. An officer was on routine patrol when he observed a vehicle going way over the speed limit. Upon further investigation, the officer found that the girl's license had been suspended for a couple months, however, she acted like she was unaware of this. When the officer asked the woman to step out of the car to issue her citations for speeding and driving with a suspended license, he started to notice signs of impairment. When he asked her how much she had to drink tonight, she brushed it off like it wasn't a big deal. The lady would start acting irrationally and would refuse to listen to the officer's commands. She even called her dad to report what the officer was doing and saying to her, thinking it could get her out of the DUI investigation. This is the body-cam footage of the events. 

#news #police #arrest
